signature: SUBROUTINE DGGBAL( JOB, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, ILO, IHI, LSCALE,

params.name: job
N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the input matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by the balanced matrix. If `JOB = 'N'`, A is not referenced.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the input matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the balanced matrix. If `JOB = 'N'`, B is not referenced.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` are set to integers such that on exit $A(i,j) = 0$ and $B(i,j) = 0$ if $i > j$ and $j = 1$,...,`ILO`-1 or $i = \mathrm{IHI}+1$,...,N. If `JOB = 'N'` or 'S', `ILO = 1` and `IHI = N`.

params.name: LSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the left side of A and B. If P(j) is the index of the row interchanged with row j, and D(j) is the scaling factor applied to row j, then

```text
LSCALE(j) = P(j)    for J = 1,...,ILO-1
          = D(j)    for J = ILO,...,IHI
          = P(j)    for J = IHI+1,...,N.
```

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: RSCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied to the right side of A and B. If P(j) is the index of the column interchanged with column j, and D(j) is the scaling factor applied to column j, then

```text
LSCALE(j) = P(j)    for J = 1,...,ILO-1
          = D(j)    for J = ILO,...,IHI
          = P(j)    for J = IHI+1,...,N.
```

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: lwork must be at least max(1,6\*N) when `JOB = 'S'` or 'B', and at least 1 when `JOB = 'N'` or 'P'.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
